InstallConfirm.zh-CN: 安装 Iris。缺少 .NET 10 桌面运行时时将由安装程序引导安装，可能需要系统权限。
InstallConfirm.en-US: Install Iris. Setup will install the .NET 10 Desktop Runtime if it is missing; system permission may be required.

UninstallChoice.zh-CN:
卸载 Iris？
选择“是”保留设置、历史和日志（默认）。
选择“否”在卸载成功后删除这些数据。
选择“取消”不作更改。
UninstallChoice.en-US:
Uninstall Iris?
Yes: keep settings, history and logs (default).
No: delete this data after uninstall succeeds.
Cancel: make no changes.

Retry.zh-CN: 维护尚未完成。程序或数据清理可能需要重试。请关闭其它 Iris 实例，选择“重试”继续；“取消”保留当前状态。
Retry.en-US: Maintenance is incomplete. Program or data cleanup may need a retry. Close other Iris instances and choose Retry, or Cancel to keep the current state.
